body:
Claim: PM loop round 1 · the director seat dispatching on the maintainer's words, verbatim 「两仓加治理行」 and the standing order 「三仓的 ci 优化卡你负责派发」 (this seat's session, 2026-10-12T13:39Z)
Session: `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`
Account: `os-zhuang`
Branch: `claude/issue-12255-workflows-governed`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12255`
Domain: `domain:devx`
Seat: `domain:devx#9`
File surface: `AGENTS.md` (the 「受管面」 section: five → six and the sentences that count or enumerate them), `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (the register row and its header list) and `scripts/__tests__/check-governed-queue-guard.test.ts`, the consumers that enumerate the surfaces (`scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`, `scripts/__tests__/merge-queue-reporting.test.ts`, `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`, `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` if it lists them), `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml` `paths:` only if it enumerates the surfaces; ⛔ not `ci.yml` (objectui#12222 in flight; objectui#12208 PR-2 queued), ⛔ not `spec-main-shape-gate.yml` (objectui#12252), ⛔ no change to `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (the default judgment tier; no path-derived mandate). Tier H (`AGENTS.md`): draft until a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` member approves; the seat then lands it.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card`
Thread-read: none
Ruling-ref: the card (the maintainer's word verbatim 「两仓加治理行」, answer A); cloud#2809 (PR #2810) as the precedent row; the objectstack sibling objectstack#23048 (claimed in this act)
Serial constraints cleared: PR #12250 (objectui#12240) is in the merge queue and touches `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` and `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`: the dev waits for its merge (minutes) and merges `origin/main` before the first commit; objectui#12222 (in flight) edits `ci.yml` and `turbo.json` only. Merge `origin/main` before opening the PR.

Released to the lane by the director seat, 2026-10-12T14:00Z: the maintainer's word this hour, verbatim 「你主要负责 ci 的优化，其他任务是车道经理的」, takes this governance card off the director seat. The dev dispatched on claim 6125447720 was stopped before any edit: it pushed only the empty claim-marker branch `claude/issue-12255-workflows-governed` at `6fb281d6` (= `origin/main` at branching; no commit, no PR, no comment, no label; worktree removed). The claim is withdrawn in this act (`pm:dispatched` → `pm:queue`, assignee released); the branch may be deleted or reused by the next seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

Facts the stopped dev read for whoever picks this up (reads only, nothing changed):
- PR #12250 (objectui#12240) is merged, so the wait the claim named is over.
- `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml` has no `paths:` filter, and the guard's self-test and test file both require that: the card's "paths: gains the glob if it enumerates" clause does not apply.
- The card's H2 is wrong as written: `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` does not read `GOVERNED_SURFACES`. After the change, a Dependabot `github-actions` bump would still be approved by `github-actions[bot]` (not an authorised approver) and queued by `dependabot-auto-merge.yml`; the `merge_group` leg would then refuse it (exit 3). The gate script's comment "such a diff touches no governed path" becomes false and is outside the claim's file surface; the next claim names it.
- Text that moves with the row: the guard's register header comment (it says `.github/workflows/**` is NOT governed) and its comment near `carrierVerdict` on restraint for workflows; the guard's self-test (the five-surfaces count, the glob string, the `this-guards-own-workflow-is-NOT-governed` case, the OK summary text); `scripts/__tests__/check-governed-queue-guard.test.ts` (the five-surfaces case and "does not govern its own workflow, or CI configuration generally"); `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` (the fixed-list sentence and the same "does not govern" sentence); `AGENTS.md` (the 五项 heading and 「上面五项已含 `skills/**`」).
- Nothing to change in `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`, `merge-queue-reporting.test.ts` or `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`: none lists the surfaces.
